INSERT INTO bookings (host_unid, slot_start, slot_end, invitee_name, invitee_email)
           SELECT $1, now() - make_interval(hours => n + 1), now() - make_interval(hours => n),
                  'Past caller', 'past@example.com'
           FROM generate_series(1, $2) AS n
           RETURNING 1
